noticias.titulo: The AI Trade Is Splitting Into Two Worlds, Goldman Sachs Says - Business Insider
noticias.resumo:
Rather than treating AI as a single global investment theme, Goldman divides Chinese AI stocks into two groups: exporters tied to Western AI spending and domestic companies benefiting from China's own AI investment, growing adoption, and policy support. 

The exporters are more sensitive to global AI investment trends and geopolitics, while domestically focused companies are more closely tied to Chinese AI spending and government policy, Goldman's strategists wrote. 

Those differences are already showing up in market performance.
